count.why: The expected set is EXACT. A third device means an address strap is wrong or something is on the bus that should not be; zero or one means a missing pull-up, the wrong pins, or an unpowered module.

elapsed_ms.why: A 112-address scan at 100 kHz takes tens of milliseconds. A scan that returns in under 5 ms did not actually walk the bus; one that takes seconds is stretching or clock-stretching on every address.
